description: [$0.002 USDC per call via x402] Islamic (Hijri) calendar: convert Gregorian↔Hijri dates and list the year's Islamic events (Ramadan start, Eid al-Fitr, Eid al-Adha, Ashura, Mawlid, Isra Mi'raj, Arafah, Laylat al-Qadr) with Gregorian dates.

date.description: Gregorian date YYYY-MM-DD to convert (default today)

hijri.description: Hijri date YYYY-MM-DD to convert to Gregorian, e.g. 1448-09-01

year.description: Gregorian year to list Islamic events for (default: the converted date's year)

name: islamic_calendar
